pages.excerpt:
1. Three Pillars of Corporate Debt
Corporate debt can be broadly categorized into three key funding sources:
(1) Bank Loans (private credit),
(2) Money Market Debt (short-term instruments), and
(3) Capital Market Debt (long-term securities)

These instruments are further categorized by sector:
• Utilities (electric, gas, water)
• Financials (banks, insurers, mortgage firms, etc.)
• Industrials (all other corporations)

In this slide, we will focus on corporate bonds, MTNs, Commercial Papers,
and Bank Loans. Convertible bonds and asset-backed securities are
addressed in other chapters.

pages.title: 3. CORPORATE DEFAULT RISK
pages.explainHtml:
评级是违约风险的「速记符号」；notch（如 A+ / A / A−）是微调。投资级 vs 投机级（高收益）是重要分界。

评级是滞后且离散的；市场信用利差往往更早反映恶化。历史违约率与回收率（recovery）用来粗估期望损失。

Approx. expected loss ≈ default rate × (1 − recovery)

pages.excerpt:
3. Corporate Debt Ratings
(a) Credit risk vs. default risk
  Default Risk = The Risk of Missing A Payment or Can’t Pay At All.
  • Example: A company goes bankrupt and stops paying interest on its
    bonds.

  Credit Risk = The Overall Risk of Losing Money
  • It includes multiple types of risk, not just missing payments.
  • Can lead to financial loss even if no default happens (for example?).

Question: think of any risk that is credit risk but not default risk?

3. Corporate Debt Ratings
 (b) Corporate debt ratings
  By Who? Rating is conducted by nationally recognized statistical rating
  organizations (NRSROs) (e.g., Moody’s, S&P, Fitch). Ratings are divided into:
      • Investment Grade (Aaa to Baa3 / AAA to BBB-)
      • Non-Investment Grade / High-Yield (Junk) (Ba1 or BB+ and below)

  Ratings reflect the probability of timely payments. Refinements (e.g., A1,
  A2, A3) indicate notch distinctions.
                  "Notches" = Small differences (e.g., A+, A, A−)

  ✓ Non-traditional bonds? Yes, especially those with fixed income risk
    (default, cash flow),
  • Market-linked bonds or derivative payoffs? No (too
    unpredictable/complicated).

4. Traditional Corporate Bonds
f. Types of High-Yield Bond Structures (垃圾债)

1. Deferred-Interest Bonds: no coupons for initial years, pays later
   – wait for interests.
2. Step-Up Bonds: coupons stars low, increase over time – starts
   low but climbs.
3. Payment-in-Kind (PIK): issuer may pay interest with more
   bonds, not cash – paid in more debt.
4. Extendable Reset Bonds: coupon resets based market rates +
   credit spreads – rate gest a reality check!

pages.excerpt:
5. Medium-Term Notes (MTNs)
What is a Medium-Term Notes (MYN)?
                MTN = “Bond Vending Machine”
•     Instead of launching one big bond at a time (like a soda
      machine that only sells one drink),
•     an MTN program lets companies or banks "vend" different
      bonds whenever they want, with different flavors:
    Feature         Can Vary? Example
    Maturity                 1 year, 5 years, 10 years
    Interest Rate            Fixed, floating, or zero
    Currency                 USD, EUR, JPY
    Special                  Linked to stocks, oil, etc. (hello,
    Features                 structured notes!)
                Question: Why Is It Called “Medium-Term Notes”?

pages.excerpt:
5. Medium-Term Notes (MTNs)
                       MTN = “Standby bond program”
 How It Works:
• Set It Once: The company sets up the MTN program (like loading the vending
   machine).
• Sell Over Time: They issue notes as needed, in small batches.
• Customize: Each note can have different terms — no two have to be the same!

Key Facts (Simple!):
• Legal Shortcut: Uses shelf registration (Rule 415) — approved once, sell many
   times.
• Maturity Range: 9 months to 30+ years.
• Who Buys? Banks, funds, insurers, sometimes even retail investors.
• Why Use It? Fast, flexible, and efficient fundraising.

pages.title: 6. COMMERCIAL PAPER
pages.explainHtml:
CP：通常 ≤1 年的短期融资，属货币市场；很多以贴现发行。信用与展期（rollover）风险关键。

易错点：CP 不是「短版债券」那么简单：披露、投资者、期限与监管框架都不同。
pages.excerpt: 6. COMMERCIAL PAPER

pages.title: 6. Commercial Paper
pages.explainHtml:
破产清偿大致优先级：Secured（有担保）≻ Unsecured senior ≻ Subordinated ≻ Equity。

同一层内部还可能有契约细节（担保品、保证、结构性后偿）。评级与价差高度依赖你在瀑布中的位置。

易错点：「高级债」若无担保，仍可能损失惨重；看的是有效优先级与回收率，不只是名字。
pages.excerpt:
6. Commercial Paper
A commercial paper (CP) 短期融资券is a short-term, unsecured
promissory note issued by corporations to finance working capital or
short-term liabilities.
• Commercial Paper (CP) is NOT considered a bond, but rather a
   short-term money market instrument.

pages.title: Quick Quiz
pages.explainHtml:
先自己在草稿纸上答，再对答案。测验的价值在于暴露「以为懂了其实不会算」的缺口。

若卡住，回到该主题对应的讲义页，把符号定义抄一遍再重做。
pages.excerpt:
Quick Quiz

1. Which debt type has priority: secured loans or equity?

2. Which is not a bond feature? (a) Maturity <1 year, (b)
Fixed coupons, (c) Sinking funds.

3. Which CLO tranche has the lowest risk? (a) Equity, (b) BBB,
(c) AAA.

pages.title: Summary & Key Takeaways
pages.explainHtml:
总结页请当成考前速查卡：能用自己的话复述每一条，才算真懂。

对照左边要点，问自己：对应公式是什么？适用假设是什么？常见反例是什么？
pages.excerpt:
Summary & Key Takeaways

• Funding Tools: Loans (private), CP (liquidity), bonds/MTNs
  (mid to long-term).
• Who Gets Paid First?: Secured creditors → Equity .
• Rating Impact: Downgrades raise costs; HY = High
  risk/reward.
• Bond Types: Callable, step-up, PIK (high-yield).
• CP ≠ Bonds: Short-term, no coupons.
• CLOs: Repackaged loans.
